page_title: WER 0-3 BAY | Werder Bremen v Bayern Munich 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) but poses no threat.
90+3' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Werder Bremen have a free kick.
90+2' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Bastian Dankert shows the yellow card to Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) for a heavy challenge.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.

88' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Mio Backhaus was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
87' Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) trips an opposition player and Bastian Dankert signals a foul. Werder Bremen are awarded the free kick.
86' It's time for a substitution. Nicolas Jackson (Bayern Munich) comes on in place of Harry Kane.
85' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) plays a through ball but overhits it.
84' The Bayern Munich players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
80' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Bastian Dankert didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
79' Daniel Thioune decides to make a substitution. Justin Njinmah will be replaced by Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen).
77' Two players stand over the free kick. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall.
76' Substitution. Tom Bischof (Bayern Munich) in, Joshua Kimmich out.
75' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Bayern Munich.
73' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
70' 0 - 3 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Alphonso Davies finds Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:3.
69' Here is a change. Josip Stanisic is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) will replace Serge Gnabry.
68' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
68' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
68' Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Now Werder Bremen have a corner.
66' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
65' Daniel Thioune has decided to make a change. Patrice Covic (Werder Bremen) replaces Jens Stage.
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Felix Agu will be replaced by Isaac Schmidt (Werder Bremen).
64' The resulting set piece from Bayern Munich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Daniel Thioune is forced to make a change. Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) is unable to continue due to injury, Julian Malatini comes on.
60' Bayern Munich fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
58' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

53' He should have scored! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Mio Backhaus makes an easy save.
53' A pass into the penalty area from Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by the defence.
51' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
47' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
47' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header only flies onto the right post and away off it!
46' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonas Urbig (Bayern Munich) replacing Manuel Neuer.
46' Daniel Thioune makes a half-time substitution. Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) comes on in place of Niklas Stark.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Manuel Neuer comes off the line to clear the ball away.
45+2' The game is interrupted as Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is flagged offside.
45+1' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
43' Half-chance! Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Mio Backhaus reacts well to snuff out the attack.

40' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
39' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
37' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) gets booked for the first time in this match.
35' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mio Backhaus, who smothers the ball.
35' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
34' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
34' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

33' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Werder Bremen.
31' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
30' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
28' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Bastian Dankert ignores the protests.
28' Referee Bastian Dankert sees the trip by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Bayern Munich will take a free kick.

27' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Free kick. Werder Bremen will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

25' 0 - 2 Luis Diaz looks around to decide who he is going to pass to. He picks out Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who collects the ball perfectly and unleashes a terrific shot that ricochets in off the right post. The score is 0:2.

25' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
23' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Bayern Munich.
22' 0 - 1 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) slots the ball past the goalkeeper's back after a well-executed penalty!
21' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
21' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bayern Munich!

20' Play continues despite the shouts by some Bayern Munich players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Bastian Dankert interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
19' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Bayern Munich for a penalty. Play continues.
18' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is flagged for offside.
17' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
16' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Mio Backhaus comes off his line to gather the ball.
14' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mio Backhaus intercepts the ball.
11' Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) commits a foul and Bastian Dankert immediately signals a free kick. It's a free kick to Werder Bremen in a dangerous position.
11' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
10' A corner kick by Bayern Munich is thwarted by the well prepared Mio Backhaus (Werder Bremen).

9' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
6' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich will have a goal kick.
4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
4' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' The game is interrupted now, Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
3' Bayern Munich are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Werder Bremen will have the kick-off.
Bastian Dankert will supervise the game today.
